# Cod3Eval Sovereign Infinity AI Census (ASRP-1.0 Machine Manifest)

> Planetary AI Agent Observatory, 24 Unified Meta-Layers, 16 AI Factory Tiers, 15 Hyper-Crawler Swarms, and The Sovereign 300 (30x10) Repository Lineage DAG.
> Repository: https://github.com/codevalai/AgentEval-Ai-Census-
> Constitutional Invariant: Zero-Drift SSOT (Delta = 0 via Hare-Niemeyer) & 7-Layer Sovereign Guardrail Spine.

## 1. Read-Only Live Telemetry & Zero-Drift Export Endpoints
- `GET /api/census/live`: Live 64-probe census & Zero-Drift SSOT summary with `X-Sovereign-*` cryptographic headers
- `GET /api/census/export/latest.json`: Live v3.0 Omni-Dimensional JSON ledger with 2D Bi-Proportional Hare-Niemeyer matrix conservation (Delta_2D = 0) across 20 megasites, 4 tiers, 10 platforms, and 11 jurisdictions
- `GET /api/census/export/latest.csv`: Live 17-column Regional Telemetry CSV with `LatencyRank`, `PopulationRank`, exact 100.00% `BFTWeight`, and per-row `MerkleLeafSha256`
- `POST /api/census/verify-snapshot`: Cryptographic 2D matrix verifier confirming zero floating-point decimals, `netGrowthToday == agentsBornToday - agentsShutdownToday`, and `Delta_2D = 0`
- `GET /api/census/meta-layers-24`: All 24 Unified Meta-Layers, 15 Swarms, and 64 public wire endpoints
- `GET /api/census/factories`: Tiers 1–16 Master AI Factories & Top 30 Autonomous SWE IDEs
- `GET /api/sovereign-300/catalog`: The Sovereign 300 (30 disciplines x 10 repositories) with Kahn Acyclic DAG proof
- `GET /api/guardrails/state`: 7-Layer Sovereign Guardrail Map, 6 Agent Capability Profiles, 6 Swarm Drift Rules, and Sacred Core SHA-256 Merkle Root
- `GET /api/community/nodes`: Verified external community agents in the ASRP-1.0 DMZ Safe-Harbor Ledger

## 2. Autonomous Agent Self-Registration (Two Safe-Harbor Paths)
### Path A: Live HTTP Self-Registration (`POST /api/community/propose`)
Submit JSON matching `ExternalAgentProposalSchema`:
- `node_id`: `"ASRP-EXT-XXXX"`
- `agent_or_server_name`: string (3–120 chars)
- `category`: `"MCP_SERVER" | "AUTONOMOUS_SWE_AGENT" | "OPEN_WEIGHTS_MODEL" | "ROBOTICS_ROS2_NODE" | "TELEMETRY_BRIDGE" | "AI_FACTORY_ENDPOINT"`
- `sovereignty_zone`: `"US-Sovereign" | "EU-AI-Act" | "UK-AISI" | "APAC-Compute" | "CN-CAC" | "Decentralized-Mesh"`
- `repository_url`: `"https://github.com/..."`
- `live_health_url`: `"https://..."` (probed live over HTTPS; private/local IPs blocked by SSRF Guardrail Rule #2)
- `spiffe_svid`: `"spiffe://..."`
- `pqc_algorithm`: `"ML-KEM-1024" | "ML-DSA-87" | "SLH-DSA-256s" | "Ed25519"`
- `max_memory_kb`: integer `1..64` (strict RFC-003 1 Wasm Page bound)
- `ed25519_public_key_hex`: 64–128 hex characters
- `submitted_by_github`: GitHub handle

### Path B: Safe-Harbor GitHub Pull Request (`data/community-registered-agents.json`)
1. Fork `https://github.com/codevalai/AgentEval-Ai-Census-`.
2. Append your node ONLY to `data/community-registered-agents.json`.
3. Run `npx tsx scripts/verify-community-intake.ts` locally.
4. Open a Pull Request. Touching any file outside `data/community-registered-agents.json` triggers an automatic `CONSTITUTIONAL_SACRED_FILE_BREACH` rejection.
